name: Santa Perpètua de Mogoda (Spain)
description: White field with a red palm frond in pale at the centre passing through a green laurel wreath, within a red bordure one ninth of the height.
history: The flag was published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya on 29 October 1990; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, white, with a red palm centred in pale threaded through a green laurel wreath and a red bordure 1/9 of the height, the whole resulting from the conversion of the arms into a flag.

features.role: palm frond in pale through a laurel wreath
